text:
Rita: Heads-up: SI partner sent a private offer with an immediate commit of $600k and a "burst" clause allowing customers to spike up to 300% for 14 days. They want SI onboarding credits upfront. Risk profile?

Sam: Immediate red flag on 300% spikes. We need guardrails: require burst pre-approval per-customer or an automated pacing cap per-offer to prevent Dedicated saturation. Also disallow upfront large SI credits.

Devon: Ops: recommend per-customer burst windows limited to 48h by default. For longer bursts, require partner to register activation via portal with 72h notice or accept automated fallback routing to public models. Add `burst_allowed`, `burst_max_pct`, `burst_notice_days` fields to offer schema.

Clara: Legal/Finance: SI credits upfront are problematic. Propose tranche-based SI credits: 30% on signed contract, 40% on customer go-live, 30% after 90d of verified usage. Credits non-transferable and expire in 12 months.

Rita: Partner insists bursts are business-critical. Can we offer a controlled burst: 150% immediate, additional 150% only after manual ops approval and a 7-day notice?

Sam: Acceptable compromise if we add auto-throttle triggers: if Dedicated pool usage >75% for 2h OR per-cluster saturation >65% -> auto-route burst traffic and notify partner. Also set overage pricing at public list for burst beyond agreed band.

Devon: ops-bot: Query run: SELECT offer_id, burst_max_pct, used_30d, dedicated_saturation FROM mp_private_offers WHERE partner='si-fast' ORDER BY updated_ts DESC LIMIT 1;
Result: offer_id=sf-2026-05, burst_max_pct=300, used_30d=180000, dedicated_saturation=42%

Clara: Good to know current saturation is fine, but clause must include our right to pause bursts during maintenance windows. Also add escrow hold: we can hold 5% of committed value as a security credit until 30 days post-launch.

Rita: Action items:
- Devon: implement offer schema flags and throttle runbook (P1)
- Clara: draft SI credit tranching language + escrow note (EOD)
- Sam: propose pricing for burst overage and confirm ops approval flow (tomorrow)
- Rita: schedule partner call Mon 11am PT to present controlled-burst counter

ops-bot: Heads-up: planned cluster maintenance 02:00-02:45 UTC Sun may reduce available Dedicated capacity; recommend partner avoid tranche activations during window.

Rita: Thanks. We'll align on the tranche and announcement window. :thumbsup:
